subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw bundle and own this Claude app-server harness and its executable bridge package, or require the harness to ship externally through ClawHub using only approved generic SDK seams?
rationale: The branch establishes long-term ownership of a provider-specific runtime, executable supply chain, credential boundary, public APIs, configuration defaults, persisted state, and shared delivery behavior; code review cannot safely choose that product boundary.

options.title: External plugin plus generic seams
options.body: Land only independently justified generic SDK gaps in narrow PRs and publish the Claude harness and bridge externally through ClawHub.

options.title: Adopt as bundled OpenClaw surface
options.body: Transfer package and security ownership to OpenClaw, then redesign core and storage seams and require complete upgrade and cross-platform proof.

options.title: Pause the architecture
options.body: Continue using the existing Anthropic provider, Claude CLI, and ACP routes rather than adding another bundled harness.

recommendation.title: External plugin plus generic seams
recommendation.body: Land only independently justified generic SDK gaps in narrow PRs and publish the Claude harness and bridge externally through ClawHub.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans the Codex app-server precedent, shared runtime auth and delivery surfaces, and repository-wide product boundaries involved in this decision.
